title: Go: practical programs, concurrency and Kubernetes controllers
summary: A complete Go learning path from your first compiled program to tested services and Kubernetes controller design. Small offline programs make language rules observable; prepared project chapters explain real integration boundaries.

lessons.title: From source text to a checked Go program
lessons.outcome: Compile and run a one-file Go program and replace a printed claim with a checked value.
lessons.lab: Start count at 1, add 1, then multiply by 3.

lessons.title: Numeric types, constants and explicit conversions
lessons.outcome: Predict integer division, narrowing conversions and floating rounding, and reject invalid numeric text instead of defaulting to zero.
lessons.lab: Multiply two explicitly int64 values of 50000.

lessons.title: Decisions, loops and invariants
lessons.outcome: Write loops with an explicit invariant that handle empty input, exact boundaries and early exit correctly.
lessons.lab: Guard access to the first element of an empty slice with a length check.
lessons.verification: The condition is false and no indexing occurs.

lessons.title: Functions and value-passing contracts
lessons.outcome: Design functions that return results and errors explicitly and show which arguments a call can or cannot change.
lessons.lab: Pass 5 to a helper that reassigns its local parameter.

lessons.title: Arrays, slices and backing-storage ownership
lessons.outcome: Predict when two slices share a backing array and make independent copies or capacity-limited appends on purpose.
lessons.lab: Take values[:1:1] and append 8.

lessons.title: Maps, presence and deterministic ordering
lessons.outcome: Distinguish a missing map key from a stored zero value and produce a deterministic report from map data.
lessons.lab: Extract keys beta and alpha and sort them.
lessons.verification: The first output key is alpha.

lessons.title: Strings, bytes, runes and Unicode boundaries
lessons.outcome: Count and slice text by bytes or runes deliberately and reject malformed UTF-8 instead of guessing.
lessons.lab: Build a string from the single byte 0xff.

lessons.title: Structs and explicit domain models
lessons.outcome: Model a small domain with structs, predict copy behavior, and validate values before they enter the model.
lessons.lab: Copy a Batch struct containing a slice and mutate its first item.
lessons.verification: The original batch observes the mutation.

lessons.title: Pointers, mutation and allocation lifetimes
lessons.outcome: Use pointers to share or update state on purpose, guard nil, and separate copying a value from mutating a target.
lessons.lab: Represent an optional integer with a nil pointer and inspect it without dereferencing.

lessons.title: Methods, interfaces and the typed-nil trap
lessons.outcome: Define behavior through interfaces and methods, choose value or pointer receivers, and detect the typed-nil interface trap.
lessons.lab: Call a value-receiver helper that increments only its receiver copy.
lessons.verification: The returned value is 4 but the original remains 3.

lessons.title: Errors as values and preserving causal context
lessons.outcome: Wrap errors with %w and recover causes with errors.Is, errors.As and errors.Join instead of comparing message text.
lessons.lab: Return a LimitError carrying an allowed maximum and inspect it with errors.As.

lessons.title: Defer, cleanup and deliberate panic boundaries
lessons.outcome: Predict defer order and argument capture, and keep cleanup running when a deliberate panic is recovered at a boundary.
lessons.lab: Defer a closure reading x, then change x to 2.

lessons.title: Packages, modules and reproducible project boundaries
lessons.outcome: Use standard-library packages through their exported API and read the module, go and toolchain directives in go.mod.
lessons.lab: Classify ParseInt, parseInt and an empty name with one rule: a name is exported when its first rune is an uppercase letter.

lessons.title: Table-driven tests and useful counterexamples
lessons.outcome: Write table-driven checks with exact endpoints and a counterexample that rejects a plausible wrong implementation.
lessons.lab: Apply clamp twice to values -2, 4 and 12.
lessons.verification: Applying it twice gives the same result as once.

lessons.title: Generics and constraints without losing semantics
lessons.outcome: Write a generic function whose constraint admits exactly the operations it needs, including named underlying types.
lessons.lab: Deduplicate 2, 1, 2 while preserving first occurrence.

lessons.title: Closures, callbacks and controlled iteration
lessons.outcome: Write closures with independent state and an iterator that stops early when its consumer breaks out of a range loop.
lessons.lab: Map a doubling callback over 1, 2 and 3.

lessons.title: Readers, writers and bounded streaming
lessons.outcome: Stream data through io.Reader and io.Writer with explicit size limits and exact record framing.
lessons.lab: Read at most three bytes from abcdef.

lessons.title: Filesystems, paths and owned cleanup
lessons.outcome: Read files through fs.FS, distinguish missing from empty files, and confine real file access to an owned directory with os.Root.
lessons.lab: Validate ../private and data/input.txt.
lessons.verification: The traversal path is invalid and the relative data path is valid.

lessons.title: JSON schemas, strict decoding and unknown input
lessons.outcome: Decode JSON strictly by rejecting unknown fields and trailing documents and preserving large integers as json.Number.
lessons.lab: Decode two adjacent JSON objects and check whether another value exists.
lessons.verification: A second value is observable, so the single-document contract fails.

lessons.title: CSV, record shape and data-quality contracts
lessons.outcome: Parse CSV with encoding/csv and reject ragged rows, blank numeric fields and wrong headers with precise errors.
lessons.lab: Parse the second field of item,12 as an integer.

lessons.title: Command-line contracts and configuration precedence
lessons.outcome: Implement a command-line interface with flag that applies explicit precedence and rejects unknown or invalid options.
lessons.lab: Parse -mystery=2.

lessons.title: HTTP handlers and in-process service tests
lessons.outcome: Write an HTTP handler and test its status codes, methods, routes and headers in process with httptest.
lessons.lab: Send GET /missing.

lessons.title: HTTP clients, cancellation and response ownership
lessons.outcome: Call an HTTP service with a cancelable context, close every response body and enforce a response size limit.
lessons.lab: Return five bytes with a maximum of four.

lessons.title: Goroutines and explicit completion
lessons.outcome: Start goroutines and prove their completion with a WaitGroup or channel instead of sleeping.
lessons.lab: Have two goroutines compute from explicit arguments.

lessons.title: Channels, buffering and close ownership
lessons.outcome: Design channel ownership so exactly one sender closes, receivers detect closure, and buffering is bounded.
lessons.lab: Run a producer sending 1 and 2 before closing output.
lessons.verification: The consumer receives exactly two values.

lessons.title: Select, contexts and cancellation trees
lessons.outcome: Combine select with context cancellation and deadlines so that work stops promptly and reports why.
lessons.lab: Cancel a child of a live parent.
lessons.verification: The child is canceled; the parent is unchanged.

lessons.title: Mutexes, atomics and shared-state invariants
lessons.outcome: Protect shared invariants with a mutex, sync.Once or typed atomics and explain which operations each one makes safe.
lessons.lab: Transfer 3 between two balances initially 5 and 5.
lessons.verification: The balances become 2 and 8; their sum remains 10.

lessons.title: Bounded worker pools and result ordering
lessons.outcome: Build a bounded worker pool that returns results in input order and leaves no goroutine running.
lessons.lab: Request zero workers.
lessons.verification: The call returns an error immediately.

lessons.title: The memory model, race diagnosis and publication
lessons.outcome: Publish data between goroutines through a channel, a closed channel or an atomic value, and explain why an unsynchronized read is a data race.
lessons.lab: Store a complete record in atomic.Value.

lessons.title: Algorithms, benchmarks and allocation-aware design
lessons.outcome: Implement a binary search with correct boundaries and compare work and allocation instead of guessing performance.
lessons.lab: Reserve capacity four, then append one value.

lessons.title: Structured logging and observable operations
lessons.outcome: Emit structured log/slog events with correlation fields and redact sensitive values before logging.
lessons.lab: Inspect the deterministic fixture record.

lessons.title: Security boundaries, escaping and input budgets
lessons.outcome: Escape output for its context, enforce input byte budgets and compare secrets in constant time.
lessons.lab: Compare ../outside with reports/item.txt.
lessons.verification: Only the second path is lexically local.

lessons.title: Repository interfaces and transaction failure policy
lessons.outcome: Model a repository transaction that commits valid changes, rolls back failures and keeps retries idempotent.
lessons.lab: Attempt a transfer larger than available balance.

lessons.title: Build targets, containers and graceful process design
lessons.outcome: Check the running build target against a supported set and model a graceful shutdown that drains work honestly.
lessons.lab: Check plan9/386 and an incomplete linux tuple with the same lookup, keeping linux/arm64 as the control.
lessons.verification: Both unsupported tuples are rejected while linux/arm64 is admitted.

lessons.title: Kubernetes objects, metadata, spec and status
lessons.outcome: Decode Kubernetes object JSON and separate desired spec from observed status, name from UID and equality from version order.
lessons.lab: Decode two objects that share namespace and name but carry different UIDs.
lessons.verification: Their names match but their identities differ.

lessons.title: Labels, selectors and service membership
lessons.outcome: Evaluate label selectors with explicit presence rules and separate selection from endpoint readiness.
lessons.lab: Require a present empty-valued label.
lessons.verification: A present empty label matches; absence does not.

lessons.title: Reconciliation as an idempotent control loop
lessons.outcome: Write a reconcile function that plans only the changes needed and becomes a no-op once state has converged.
lessons.lab: Observe an existing child already at count 3.

lessons.title: Resource versions and optimistic concurrency
lessons.outcome: Implement optimistic concurrency that rejects stale resource versions and rereads current state before a retry.
lessons.lab: Read the current token after conflict and recompute an increment.
lessons.verification: The new value is based on current state.

lessons.title: List-watch continuity, bookmarks and expired history
lessons.outcome: Apply list-watch events to a local cache and restart from a fresh list when watch history has expired.
lessons.lab: Apply a bookmark without an object.
lessons.verification: The version advances and no item is created.

lessons.title: Work queues, retry budgets and error classification
lessons.outcome: Classify failures as retryable or invalid and bound retries with capped delays and a total budget.
lessons.lab: Enqueue alpha twice and beta once in a set model.

lessons.title: A real client-go project and explicit cluster configuration
lessons.outcome: Configure a client-go project from an explicit, secure cluster configuration and refuse ambient credentials.
lessons.lab: Omit the context name.

lessons.title: Informer caches, stale reads and safe object copies
lessons.outcome: Read from an informer-style cache safely by copying before mutation, gating on synchronization and queueing keys.
lessons.lab: Deliver only the first of two watch events to a cache that starts at version a.
lessons.verification: The cache shows b while the server's latest version is already c.

lessons.title: Finalizers, deletion and exact ownership
lessons.outcome: Use a finalizer to finish exact-owner cleanup before deletion completes, without removing other controllers' finalizers.
lessons.lab: Inspect a deleting object with outstanding owned cleanup.

lessons.title: Service accounts, RBAC and least-authority controllers
lessons.outcome: Derive a least-authority RBAC rule set from a controller's actual reads and writes.
lessons.lab: Use the lesson rule against another namespace.

lessons.title: Leader election, leases and fencing limits
lessons.outcome: Model lease-based leader election and explain why a fencing check is still needed after a takeover.
lessons.lab: Let a renew its lease before expiry.

lessons.title: Admission decisions, webhook contracts and failure policy
lessons.outcome: Write an admission decision function that validates exact boundaries, echoes the request UID and has no side effects in dry run.
lessons.lab: Validate counts 5 and 6 against maximum 5.
lessons.verification: Five is allowed and six is denied.

lessons.title: Controller tests from pure functions to owned clusters
lessons.outcome: Test controller logic with fakes that count calls and preserve error causes before running against an owned cluster.
lessons.lab: Cancel context before invoking the adapter.

lessons.title: Capstone: a reliable, resumable controller design
lessons.outcome: Design a resumable controller that converges from any starting state, refuses replacement objects and survives restarts.
lessons.lab: Supply expected UID old while observed UID is new.
lessons.verification: No write occurs and an ownership error is returned.
